cs.t: Under $100 > Earfun Air Pro 3 - I wanted an affordable wireless earbud with great sound and decent ANC as an alternative to my Airpods Pro 1. This has pleasantly surprised me, and I use it more now than my aging Airpod Pro 1. Under $1000 > Mackage down winter jacket my partner bought me 10 years ago. Investing in a great winter jacket makes winters much, much, much more bearable!
cs.th: Ask HN: Life-changing purchases since 2020? (Under $100 and under $1000)
